meta.description: Registry of known mathematical failure modes for reconstruction and inversion.

failure_modes.name: many_to_one_projection
failure_modes.description: Distinct preimages map to the same observation.

failure_modes.name: lost_residue_history
failure_modes.description: Projection erases historical residue markers required for inversion.

failure_modes.name: orientation_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Multiple orientation frames produce indistinguishable projections.

failure_modes.name: non_unique_preimage
failure_modes.description: Inversion results in an equivalence class rather than a point.

failure_modes.name: empty_preimage
failure_modes.description: Observation corresponds to no admissible formal state.

failure_modes.name: transport_path_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Multiple transport histories produce the same CSI membership.

failure_modes.name: threshold_indistinguishability
failure_modes.description: States near admissibility thresholds cannot be distinguished.

failure_modes.name: residue_equivalence_class_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Observation only determines residue up to a broad class.
